scenes.name: Matter tools
scenes.text:
Matter tools
The papers you add here are kept as text in our store, in the EU (Romania), until you delete the paper or the matter. Keep the matter number: it is lost when you reload this page, and your matters cannot be listed here. Deleting removes them from this service's store. For a scanned paper, the text read from its pages is kept, with the position of each passage on its page, the page's pixel size, the reading confidence and a note of how each page was read; the page images are not written to our store.

scenes.name: The tools, part 1
scenes.text:
Papers for a matter
Add the papers of a matter and find a passage in them.
Uses your papers
Chronology
Lists the dates it reads in your papers, each with its sentence. May be incomplete.
Uses your papers
Review agenda
Lists the ingredients of the cheque-dishonour offence and the papers to look in.
Uses your papers
Citation sweep
Checks that each citation in your papers exists in our index, nothing more.
Uses your papers

scenes.name: The tools, part 2
scenes.text:
Quashing agenda
Lists the Supreme Court's quashing categories; does not say whether any applies.
Uses your papers
Cheque case check
Shows the review agenda and candidate dates per step; you confirm each date.
Uses your papers
Hearing pack
Gathers the dates, papers still to add and citations to look up for a hearing.
Uses your papers
Section 138 checklist
Counts section 138 periods from dates you confirm: a checklist, not a decision.

scenes.name: What is kept, part 1
scenes.text:
Papers you add to a matter
What is sent: each paper you add on Matter tools is sent to our service. Only its text is kept; for a scanned paper, that includes the position of each passage on its page, the page's pixel size, the reading confidence and a note of how each page was read.
Where it is kept: in our store on a storage volume in the EU (Romania), not in India.
How long: until you delete the paper or the matter. Nothing expires it, and we make no promise of a retention period.

scenes.name: What is kept, part 2
scenes.text:
What delete does: deleting a paper or a matter removes it, its stored text and the details kept with it, from this service's store. We have not tested what the underlying hosting storage may still hold.
Who can read it: only your organisation, through the product or your organisation's API key; another organisation gets "not found".
This service does not encrypt the stored files. People who run the service and its hosting account can read them.

scenes.name: What is kept, part 3
scenes.text:
Backup: none known. This service makes no copy, and we have not tested what our hosting provider keeps.
The matter number is lost when you reload the page, and your matters cannot be listed here.
If you lose the matter number, there is not yet a tested way to ask us to delete your papers.

scenes.name: Sample matter
scenes.text:
Load a sample matter
The sample matter is invented: an invented FIR, chargesheet extract, bail order and cheque memo, with no real parties.

scenes.name: This is a screening aid, not legal advice. A lawyer decides.
